answer: Every agent must lock a minimum bond in a shared vault before its proposals can enter the task queue. A narrow inlet rate-limits new bonds, while the bond is held through a review period and slashed if the agent submits provably fraudulent work. Creating a thousand fake identities therefore requires a thousand locked deposits, and successful attacks can destroy that capital; splitting one bond among aliases earns no extra influence. Even shale-backed collateral has an opportunity cost while locked.
